environment: localhost:8080 code -> existing SSH sidecar -> native Ollama on shunbun (192.168.1.31), qwen3:8b, two native slots, thinking disabled
method: Public synthetic questions reused from the review. Calls exercise aiCoachGenerate through the live configured connection. Warm sequential and concurrent measurements exclude HTTP authentication, browser rendering, and the new application queue. Separate disposable integration tests cover actual HTTP enqueue, two worker processes, status recovery, navigation, cancellation, and backend failure. No operational accounts or business records were changed for benchmarking.
quality_notes: The first one-call benchmark was faster but still invented date navigation, task-assignment steps, and booked-visit entry, and missed organization restoration. This led to source-verified procedures rather than accepting speed as correctness.

Final sampled answers used verified date editing, assignment, restoration, calendar subscription, attachment removal, and tab instructions. A subsequent file-save follow-up guard corrected an unrelated backup citation; its behavior is covered by a dedicated helper regression.
One-time private calendar links, role limits, and irreversible actions remain governed by the real application. The coach does not execute them.
verification: PHP helper checks covering all 16 source-verified procedures and 4 interactive workflows
Disposable HTTP tests: auth, CSRF, role refresh, feedback, review/approval, export, log-clear retention
Queue tests: eight-job admission, unique claims, cancellation races, owner/role scope, expired deadlines
Actual two-worker execution plus POST 202, navigation, GET completion, and unavailable-backend diagnostics
PHPStan helper and route configurations passed
Manual built/verified; rendered pages 23-24 inspected; installed PDF index hash verified
Asset consistency and seven isolated-network allocator tests passed
limitations: Known regression questions and warm/reused prompts; not an untouched held-out quality benchmark.
No p95 browser or cold-start SLA is claimed. The application has a 20-second queue-plus-generation budget, with bounded recovery; outages/browser suspension can still exceed wall-clock targets.

Live-browser testing with a newly created temporary administrator was blocked by automated approval; no such account was created. Authenticated flows were verified in the disposable test environment instead.
Sixteen new procedures were verified against source and manual. Four workflows have interactive DOM highlighting; remaining procedures give numbered guidance without full highlighting.
Unmatched questions still use model-generated explanations, which can be wrong. Embeddings, streaming, and model fine-tuning were not introduced.

first_one_call_run.question: What are some of the functions of the moed app?

answer.message: MOED connects event planning, people, communication, and next actions. It helps manage inquiries, engagements, tasks, and financial closeouts. The app also supports calendar subscriptions and maintains a clear workflow for event readiness.

sources.title: The Record Model at a Glance

first_one_call_run.question: I'm new here. What can this help our ministry organize?

answer.message: This platform helps organize your ministry's events, contacts, and tasks. It supports managing engagements, tracking financial closeouts, and maintaining communication through Chron and email. It also allows you to connect with Mattermost for team collaboration.

first_one_call_run.question: How do I add a new event?

answer.message: In MOED, an event is called an engagement. Start with New Engagement, then choose its Organization within that form. I’ll guide you one step at a time from your current page.

first_one_call_run.question: We've booked a weekend teaching visit. How should I get it onto the schedule?

answer.message: To add the booked teaching visit to the schedule, first archive the inquiry as it is now booked. Then, edit the event details and set the start and end dates. Finally, save the changes to schedule the event.

sources.title: Archive a booked or declined inquiry

first_one_call_run.question: I don't want to create a new event. I need to find the one already entered.

answer.message: To find an existing event, open Engagements, then use the search filters (title, organization, contact, chron log text, and/or user) to locate it. Click the event’s title to view details. If you need to edit it, select Edit Engagement from the details page. For help with specific steps, let me know.

first_one_call_run.question: How do I add a second day to an existing event?

answer.message: To add a second day to an existing event, first, open the Engagement Details page. Navigate to the 'Logistics' tab and update the end date to include the additional day. Ensure all related details, such as presentations and contacts, are adjusted to reflect the new schedule. Save Changes to apply the updates. Refer to the 'Create or Edit an Engagement' guide for detailed steps on modifying event details. (Evidence ID: 2)

first_one_call_run.question: Can I attach a PowerPoint directly to an engagement?

answer.message: A PowerPoint is attached to an individual presentation. Let’s find that presentation and its PPT Slidedeck field, then save the file.

first_one_call_run.question: How do I remove a PowerPoint from a presentation?

answer.message: To remove a PowerPoint from a presentation, go to the Edit Presentations tab on the event's page. Find the presentation, select 'Remove current PPT' checkbox, review the removal pending notice, then click 'Save Changes' in the persistent bottom bar. This action hides the QR code and stops downloads until a new file is uploaded.

sources.title: Upload or replace PDF notes and a PowerPoint
A Presentation File or Its QR Code Is Missing

first_one_call_run.question: How do I add speaker notes?

answer.message: Speaker-notes PDFs belong to individual presentations. Let’s find the presentation, choose its PDF, and save it. I’ll guide you from this page.

first_one_call_run.question: How do I add a task to an event?

answer.message:
To add a task to an event, follow these steps:
1. Open the Engagement Details page.
2. Click the Tasks tab.
3. Select Add Task.
4. Fill in the task details: title, notes, owner, due date, and priority.
5. Click Add task to save.

first_one_call_run.question: How do I assign a follow-up to another team member?

answer.message: To assign a follow-up to another team member, first create the follow-up task in the Work Queue. Open the engagement linked to the channel, then go to Tasks > Add Task. Enter a title and notes, choose a due date and priority, and assign the task to the team member. Save the task to add it to the engagement's work queue.

first_one_call_run.question: I have to wait for the church to call me back. How should I track that?

answer.message: To track waiting for the church to call you back, create a task in the Work Queue. Open the task creation form, enter a title like 'Await Church Call,' and add notes about the expected response. Save the task to keep it organized. You can review or update it later in the Work Queue.

first_one_call_run.question: I marked it Waiting. What goes in the other box?

answer.message: The other box is for the name of the person, organization, or decision that the task is waiting on. For example, if the task is waiting on a client's approval, enter "Client Approval" in the box. This helps track who or what is needed to move the task forward.

first_one_call_run.question: How can I see these events in Apple Calendar on my phone?

answer.message: To see events in Apple Calendar, first create a private calendar subscription link in the Calendar section. Tap 'Create Subscription', select your device or service, choose the content, and click 'Create Private Link'. After creating it, 'Save This New Link' appears with a one-time URL. Copy this URL into your Apple Calendar app to sync events. Ensure your phone's calendar app is updated and properly configured to receive the subscription.

sources.title: Use the daily agenda on a phone

first_one_call_run.question: Can I delete the required financial closeout reminder?

answer.message: The built-in financial closeout reminder is required. It cannot be removed or archived to bypass closeout. Are you trying to complete a closeout, or change an optional Standard Event Task?

first_one_call_run.question: Can you show me how to upload slides?

answer.message: Your current role is read-only. You can view the available records, but an editor or administrator must make this change. I can explain the process without directing you to controls your role cannot use.

first_one_call_run.question: How do I restore an archived organization?

answer.message: To restore an archived organization, navigate to the Organizations page. Look for the archived organization in the list. There is no direct restore option for organizations based on the provided information. Please check if there is another method or consult with your administrator for further assistance.

first_one_call_run.question: The presentation upload didn't work. What should I check?

answer.message: Check if you selected 'Choose PDF' or 'Choose PPT' for the file, and ensure the file size is within limits (PDF: 100 MB, PowerPoint: 500 MB). Also, confirm you clicked 'Save Changes' in the bottom bar to apply the upload. If the file still doesn’t appear, verify the filename and upload details after saving.

sources.title: Upload or replace PDF notes and a PowerPoint

first_one_call_run.question: What's the difference between an inquiry and an engagement?

answer.message: An Inquiry is for a potential event that hasn't been booked yet. It holds early communication and follow-up. An Engagement is created once an organization, title, and preferred date range are known, converting the Inquiry into a booked event. The Inquiry then becomes read-only and linked for reference. Evidence: Inquiry First, Engagement After Booking (p. 13).

first_one_call_run.question: Thanks, that helped.

answer.message: You’re welcome. I’m here when you need help with the next step.

first_one_call_run.question: What time is it?

answer.message: Good day, editor!

first_one_call_run.question: Can MOED automatically send invoices and take card payments?

answer.message: MOED does not have a documented invoice-generation tool. Financials records event payments, expenses, and closeout information; it does not create an invoice for you.

first_one_call_run.question: I can't see Edit Presentations. I'm on the Activity tab.

answer.message: To see Edit Presentations, switch to the Presentations tab first. Then, the Edit Presentations option will be visible.

first_one_call_run.question: I've selected the Presentations tab. What's next?

answer.message: Next, check the selected speaker. Choose a PDF for Speaker Notes or a .ppt or .pptx file for PPT Slidedeck. Save Changes to update the file. The corresponding QR code appears after the file is saved successfully.

answer.message: Click Save Changes in the persistent bottom bar to apply the file selection and finalize the update.

answer.message: To create an engagement, you need to go to the Engagements section and select + New Engagement. Organization Details does not have a direct create-event action. Once there, choose the active organization inside the form to proceed.
